title: Walkthrough Edit Decision List
description: The single interface between the creative cut (which takes, in what order, trimmed how) and the deterministic render engine (03_build.py). Authored by Claude+Will (assisted mode) or by a Max agent (auto mode). Everything below the 'segments' list is mechanical; the segments list IS the edit.

notes.description: Editor's rationale — why these takes, what was cut and why (repetition, flubs, dead air).

segments.description: The final cut, in playback order. Each entry is one kept span of one raw clip.

in.description: In-point in the source clip, seconds.

out.description: Out-point in the source clip, seconds.

chapter.description: Optional label (e.g. 'Intro', 'Chart 1 · Days on Market') — carried into the storyboard, not the render.

face_cx.description: Normalised horizontal face centre 0..1 for this clip's crop. Auto-detected by 01/02; override if the auto-centre is off.

zoom.description: Per-segment punch-in override (defaults to config.framing.zoom). Use a slightly different zoom on adjacent same-topic takes to avoid a jump-cut.

look.description: Per-segment grade overrides (any subset of config.look) — e.g. a clip shot in different light.

transcript.description: For reference only (what Will says in this span). Ignored by the render; the final captions are re-transcribed from the assembled audio.

drop.description: If true, keep the row for the record but exclude it from the render (a documented cut).
